name: paper-lens
description: Quickly read a paper, then deepen the same report into a source-grounded reviewer-level analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Quick and reviewer-level paper reading in one report.
interface.longDescription: Read an arXiv paper or local PDF quickly, continue into a reviewer-level deep analysis, and keep both stages in one source-grounded Markdown report.
defaultPrompt: Use $paper-lens to quickly read this arXiv paper.
Use $paper-lens to deeply review this local PDF.
Continue the current Paper Lens report in deep mode.
